verdict.rationale: Base44 docs mention 'connecting to its sandbox' for bring-your-own-agent workflows and a CLI 'clone/eject' command that spins up a separate project with its own app ID, both of which imply an isolated environment distinct from the live app. However, there is no explicit documentation of a staging/sandbox mode with synced-but-isolated production data, nor guidance on safely testing without affecting production records. Missing for 10: explicit staging environment docs, data-isolation guarantees, and any hands-on/community confirmation that sandbox testing avoids touching production data.
